blockers: Stereo widener has no audible effect — side limiter (kSideCeiling=0.06) crushes all stereo content because voice and reverb share one output bus. Fix requires spu94_process_split() to separate voice and reverb outputs.

decisions.decision: Tremolo/auto-pan/AM/phase-mod are the sweep in retrigger mode — no separate LFO
decisions.rationale: VCA ramp IS the modulator, effects are configurations of existing hardware

decisions.decision: Side limiter must stay — protects against reverb feedback squeals
decisions.rationale: Removing it made reverb unlistenable with hard-panned content

decisions.decision: Fix is split-output bus, not removing the limiter
decisions.rationale: Side-limit reverb only, voice stereo effects pass through clean

decisions.decision: Stereo widener needs post-limiter placement OR split bus to work
decisions.rationale: Pre-limiter widening gets crushed; post-limiter widening amplifies near-zero side content

next_action: Implement spu94_process_split() in C core, then rewire PluginProcessor to side-limit reverb only. After that, UAT remaining effects (widener, mod bus).
context_notes: v1.10.0 phases 43-51 all planned and executed. UAT found auto-pan bugs (fixed), stereo widener blocked by side limiter architecture. GUI layout changed to two-column (left: tremolo/auto-pan/AM/phase-mod, right: duck/widener/mod-bus). All 35 sweep tests + 63 voice tests + 6 rt_safety gates pass.
